description: Edit the user's OWN footage (clips they uploaded: vlogs, talking heads, interviews, raw takes, and also footage with no talking such as travel clips, product b-roll, gameplay or AI clips, or a mix) into one finished video. Talking is cut by what is said (pauses and filler words cut), footage without talking by what is shown (a montage of the best shots, or b-roll over the talking). Clips put in order, word-by-word captions on speech, a logo, and a music bed when given. Then make new numbered versions from change requests (action "revise"). It does not generate video (use pixeldojo_generate or pixeldojo_storyboard), does not change how a clip looks with AI (pixeldojo_video), and does not edit images (pixeldojo_edit). For one long recording that should become several separate shorts, use pixeldojo_clipper. It cannot add generated b-roll, sound effects or visual effects yet; a music bed only comes from a music_url you pass. Upload local files first with pixeldojo_upload. 1 to 12 clips, 5 seconds to 30 minutes in total, MP4 or MOV, with or without speech. The first version costs 3 credits per started minute of footage (at least 6), each later version 3, charged only when that version is delivered; tell the user the price before starting. Then call status until done (about 1 to 5 minutes).

action.description: start (default): begin an edit. status: check an edit by editor_id; call about every 30 s until it is done. revise: ask for a change to the latest version (editor_id + note).

at_sec.description: Revise: the moment in the latest version the note is about, in seconds.

caption_style.description: Start: caption look. designed = big poster-style words laid out around the speaker, the key word of each phrase huge. Leave it out and the editor picks from the instructions (pop unless they ask for bold or animated captions).

editor_id.description: Status / revise: the id start returned.

format.description: Start: the shape. Leave it out and the editor picks.

instructions.description: Start: what the edit should be, in the user's own words.

logo_url.description: Start: a logo on the PixelDojo CDN. Leave it out to use the brand kit logo, if there is one.

music_url.description: Start: a music bed on the PixelDojo CDN (make one first with an audio model). Worth passing for footage with no talking.

note.description: Revise: the change, in the user's words.

title.description: Start: a name for the edit; versions are saved in a Library folder with it.

video_url.description: Start: a single clip (same as video_urls with one item).

video_urls.description: Start: the user's clips on the PixelDojo CDN, in any order (upload local files first with pixeldojo_upload). MP4 or MOV, 5 seconds to 30 minutes in total. Talking, no talking (travel, b-roll, gameplay, AI clips) or a mix.

name: pixeldojo_editor
title: Edit your footage
